text_blocks.text: My question for you is, it might be a tough one. You played with one of the most dominant players in the game, Shaquille O'Neal. I've been hearing a lot of whispers. text_blocks.text: Shaq got to guard him too. Shaq got to guard him. True that. I'm just, this is what some of the viewers want to know. You've been around the league. Would you want to guard a motherfucker that can score every time in the post, or would you want to guard a motherfucker that's going to sometimes make a three-point shot on the perimeter? Who you going to want to guard?

text_blocks.speaker: Zach Randolph
text_blocks.text: I'm going to want to guard the three-point shooter. It's literally that simple. Because think about this, you don't have to double the Nikola Jokic. Shaq, they don't have to leave off nobody if Shaq is guarding the Nikola Jokic. All he got to do is lay contest. And sometimes it's going to go in, sometimes it's not. But on that other end, Nikola Jokic can't fuck with Shaq. And Nikola Jokic is cold. Don't get it twisted. Nikola Jokic is cold. But Nikola Jokic cannot guard Shaq in the post. Like, it's that simple.
